name: Acme
description: A fixture that extends the vocabulary in every way a layer may.

tanrei.sys.space.space1200.rationale: Hero sections need a 96px rhythm step.

tanrei.sys.color.brand-glow.rationale: The glow behind the hero artwork; never used for text.

tanrei.sys.motion.spring.standard.bouncy.rationale: The rating stars land with a visible bounce; no core spring overshoots this much.

tanrei.sys.motion.spring.expressive.boun.rationale: The rating stars land with a visible bounce; no core spring overshoots this much.

tanrei.comp.button.size.3x.rationale: A hero call-to-action on the landing screen.

tanrei.comp.button.variant.danger.rationale: Destructive confirmation is a distinct emphasis in this product.

tanrei.sys.state.hover-state-layer-opaci.reason: Acme tells hovered, focused and pressed apart by three different strengths (also what makes BTN-3 observable in tests).

tanrei.sys.state.focus-state-layer-opaci.reason: Acme tells hovered, focused and pressed apart by three different strengths.

tanrei.sys.state.pressed-state-layer-opa.reason: Acme tells hovered, focused and pressed apart by three different strengths.

tanrei.sys.behavior.focus-style.reason: Acme shows keyboard focus as a glow.

tanrei.sys.icon.family.unselected.reason: Acme uses the static Material Icons set: outlined when unselected.

tanrei.sys.icon.family.selected.reason: Acme uses the static Material Icons set: filled when selected.

tanrei.sys.icon.weight.reason: A static icon font has one weight; 400 is what Material Icons is drawn at.

tanrei.sys.icon.mark.weight.reason: A static icon set has one weight to draw: a control's mark takes the icons'.

tanrei.sys.motion.spring.standard.bouncy.reason: A visible bounce: half the critical damping.

tanrei.sys.motion.spring.expressive.boun.reason: The expressive scheme bounces a little more.
A slower, rounder bounce in the expressive scheme.
